title: TAM-Eval: Evaluating LLMs for Automated Unit Test Maintenance
datasets: TAM-Eval v1: 1,539 whole-test-file creation/repair/update tasks from 192 repos across Python, Java and Go; no issue-linked bug benchmark.
models: Paper: Devstral-Small, Qwen3-480B-A35B, DeepSeek V3.1, GPT-OSS-120B, Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5. Public run script currently lists different models via OpenRouter.
input_setting: Focal source+test file, whole-file rewrite; up to three attempts with execution feedback
reproduction_grade: B- (conditional: public source/data and configurable API, but model script mismatch and no cached outputs found)
limitation: Does not use SWT-Bench/Defects4J/BugsInPy bug instances; public run_model_evals.sh models do not match paper Table II and snapshots are unpinned. Good for own-model test-maintenance evaluation, not issue-to-test reproduction or causal root-cause analysis.
task: Test-suite maintenance benchmark; Create, Repair, Update; measures pass rate, coverage delta and mutation delta
